tools.description: Retrieves relevant document snippets from your Pinecone Assistant knowledge base. Returns an array of text snippets from the most relevant documents. You can use the 'top_k' parameter to control result count (default: 15). Recommended top_k: a few (5-8) for simple/narrow queries, 10-20 for complex/broad topics.

assistant_name.description: Name of an existing Pinecone assistant

query.description: The query to retrieve context for.

top_k.description: The number of context snippets to retrieve. Defaults to 15.

tools.name: assistant_context
